answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch identity commitment and evaluate its polynomial to derive rate-limit proofs and nullifiers. A Semaphore-style proof hides the secret while binding each message to that epoch. Reusing a nullifier exposes two Shamir shares; anyone can interpolate the private key, verify the violation, and trigger immediate collateral slashing. The prism of proofs anchors accountability, while crystal-clear epoch separation prevents cross-epoch leakage.
